title: B1: a live stage agent is the only liveness signal, but this repo never records one
context: The owner answered that another session may take over a change as soon as no stage agent is alive for it, so an open stage with no live stage agent does not block. liveStageAgents only sees stage-agent rows with event_status started, which the SubagentStart hook (stage-agent-start.mjs, recordStageAgentStart) should write. In this repo no bundle has a single started stage-agent row (0 across all bundles) and hooks.log has no stage-agent-start line at all. The 753 bundle at 2026-10-28T17:21:40Z had development, checks and documentation_sync open from session c08524c9 but no live stage agent. Under the answer as given, B1 would not have blocked the observed takeover and in practice blocks nothing here; B2 (branch check) and B3 (merged close) still fix today's stray row and close 753.

options.label: Treat an open stage from another session as live while a stage agent is live OR that session wrote a row in the bundle within the last 30 minutes. A crashed session stops blocking 30 minutes after its last row. Reproduces and blocks the observed 753 case.
